name: dwarview
blurb: The dwarview is a GUI program that displays DWARF debug info in a binary file as a tree.
description:
The dwarview is a GUI program that displays DWARF debug info in a binary file as a tree.
It also supports to search functions and variables by name (with glob pattern).
It's written in C using GTK+3 and libdw library from elfutils.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
